title: Tripful: AI Travel Planner
description:
Tripful — your AI travel planner built around real travelers, not recycled advice.

Plan your next vacation with a smart AI trip planner that combines a personal travel concierge with honest advice from people who just got back. No sponsored rankings, no outdated blogs — just a trip planner app that actually learns how you travel.

🤖 AI Concierge — Your Personal Travel Planner
Set up your traveler profile once. Tell Tripful your pace, budget, and travel style — and your AI Concierge builds detailed day-by-day trip itineraries with real restaurant names, neighborhoods, local prices, and insider tips. Adjust on the fly, save your trip plans, or export as a PDF. This isn't generic trip planning — it's a personalized vacation planner that gets smarter the more you use it.

🗺️ Itinerary Planner & Maker
Build your travel itinerary day by day. Use the itinerary maker to organize activities, map out your route, and create a trip plan you can actually follow. Whether you're building a road trip planner route across the country or a weekend city itinerary, Tripful makes destination planning simple.

🔔 Real-Time Flight & Hotel Price Alerts
Set your travel dates and Tripful monitors flight and hotel prices around the clock. The moment prices drop, you get notified. One tap to book on Expedia — no switching apps, no missed deals. The best free travel planner for finding deals. Available on Premium.

💬 Ask Real Travelers
Whether it's safe to walk at night in Medellín, which neighborhood in Tokyo works best for first-timers, or how much you actually need per day in Portugal — get honest, recent answers from travelers who were just there. Not recycled advice from 2019. Perfect for solo travel, budget travel, or planning your first trip itinerary to a new destination.

✈️ Build & Share Trip Plans
Plan your trip day by day with the itinerary trip planner. Keep your travel itinerary private or share it publicly for feedback. Browse how other travelers structure their trip itineraries, what they'd skip, and what they'd do differently. Trip planning is better when real people are involved.

📖 Travel Log — Share Your Trip Story
Just got back? Share what worked, what to skip, and what you wish you'd known. Your travel log helps the next traveler build a smarter trip plan — and keeps Tripful's advice fresh and trustworthy.

🌍 Travel in Any Language
Ask questions, read stories, and chat with your AI Concierge in your own language. Tripful works across multiple languages so you can plan trips and connect with travelers worldwide — no translation needed.

✅ Smart Trip Checklist
Never miss your passport, visa requirements, travel insurance, or charger again. Tripful generates a smart packing and prep checklist tailored to every destination and trip type. Your journey planner handles the details so you don't forget.

🏨 One-Tap Booking
Book flights, hotels, vacation rentals, tours, car rentals, travel insurance, and eSIMs — all directly from your trip plan. A complete travel organizer and holiday planner in one app.

⭐ Why Travelers Choose Tripful
→ AI travel planner that learns your travel style and budget
→ Real answers from recent travelers — no sponsored content
→ Flight and hotel price alerts with one-tap booking
→ Itinerary maker to build, share, export, and refine trip plans
→ Free trip planner for solo travel, couples, families, and groups
→ Group travel planner features for collaborative trip planning
→ Travel itinerary planner with drive planner and route mapping
→ Free to use — Premium unlocks price alerts and advanced planning

Download Tripful — the AI trip planner and travel itinerary app for travelers who want real advice, not algorithms.

WE'RE BUILDING THIS WITH YOU
Tripful gets better with every trip you take and every idea you share. Got a feature request, found a bug, or just want to tell us about your last trip? 
We read every message — support@tripful.app
